study_design: Prevalent new-user matched retrospective database cohort of patients with osteoarthritis
cohort_total_n_excerpt: The study cohort of patients with osteoarthritis included 20,541 glucosamine initiators who were matched to 20,541 non-users.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: For lung cancer, the HR with glucosamine treatment was 0.99 (95% CI 0.83-1.18), whereas it was 1.11 (95% CI 0.93-1.33) for colorectal cancer, 1.07 (95% CI 0.93-1.23) for breast cancer in women, and 1.03 (95% CI 0.88-1.22) for prostate cancer.
estimate_classifications.reason: This estimate is explicitly for prostate cancer incidence without an aggressive-disease restriction.
